_description: Prior-focused investigation. PPO is held constant throughout (the active model in config.json). Each experiment isolates ONE dimension of the residual-policy mechanism so any Sharpe difference can be attributed to that one knob. Run in three rounds (see _notes at bottom) for a paced exploration; or all 8 at once for an overnight sweep.
_notes: BASE CONFIG STATE — policy_prior.type='equal_weight', alpha=0.5. So 'baseline' = empty overrides = equal_weight @ alpha=0.5. — — — STRUCTURE — — — ROUND 1 — does the prior matter at all?   names: baseline, prior_off.   baseline gives equal_weight @ alpha=0.5 (the current config); prior_off disables the prior entirely (pure DRL). If baseline beats prior_off, the prior provides real lift. ROUND 2 — does the prior TYPE matter?   names: type_inverse_vol, type_risk_parity.   Both held at baseline's alpha=0.5; only the type changes. Compared to baseline (equal_weight). ROUND 3 — does the blending strength alpha matter?   the alpha grid generates 4 cells named alpha_alpha0.0, alpha_alpha0.25, alpha_alpha1.0, alpha_alpha2.0.   Held at baseline's type=equal_weight. alpha=0.0 is identical to prior_off behaviour-wise (determinism cross-check). alpha=0.5 is omitted because it overlaps baseline. — — — STAGED EXECUTION (recommended) — — — Round 1: 'python run_experiments.py --experiments experiments.json --only baseline,prior_off --with-backtrader' (~2-4h). Look at the ranked table. Decide whether to proceed. Round 2: '--only type_inverse_vol,type_risk_parity --with-backtrader' (~2-4h). Round 3: '--only alpha_alpha0.0,alpha_alpha0.25,alpha_alpha1.0,alpha_alpha2.0 --with-backtrader' (~4-8h). — — — ALL AT ONCE — — — Drop the --only flag: 'python run_experiments.py --experiments experiments.json --with-backtrader' (~8-16h overnight).
